description: This is a test script for the 'model_response_utils' module, specifically testing the 'is_model_response_stream_empty' function with different 'ModelResponseStream' objects.

classes.name: ModelResponseStream
classes.description: A class representing a stream of model responses, containing fields like id, created timestamp, model name, object type, system fingerprint, choices, and provider-specific fields.

classes.name: StreamingChoices
classes.description: A class representing a choice in a streaming response, including finish reason, index, delta, and log probabilities.

classes.name: Delta
classes.description: A class representing the delta of a streaming choice, with various optional fields such as content, role, function call, etc.

methods.name: test_is_model_response_stream_empty()
methods.description: A test case that creates an empty 'ModelResponseStream' object and asserts that the 'is_model_response_stream_empty' function returns True.

methods.name: test_is_model_response_stream_empty_with_custom_value()
methods.description: A test case that creates a 'ModelResponseStream' object, modifies the 'delta' field to add a custom attribute, and asserts that the 'is_model_response_stream_empty' function returns False.
